reader.requirement: At --std 85, under Format 1 (RECORD CONTAINS integer-1 CHARACTERS), every record description entry of the file whose size (its maximum, for a record with OCCURS DEPENDING ON; redefinitions not counted; sign separate and every elementary item counted) exceeds integer-1 must be refused, and records of integer-1 or fewer character positions accepted.

edition-consulted.switches: edition.DialectLevel >= Since; the SR3 row (1985 SR1) has Since 85, so it applies at 85 as at 2023
below 2002 the diagnostic cites the row's Of1985 rule (§1985:VII.3.8.3 SR1) instead of §2023:13.18.43.3 SR3

probes.expected: legal source compiles; this crash is outside SR1 (it occurs with no RECORD clause too)

citations.check: OK  §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR1  (3.8.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR1

reader.notes: The RECORD clause table's Format 1 row applies from 85 and compares the record maximum, so the refusal half holds for plain, ODO, sign-separate and redefining records in all three organizations. The message body says bytes where the 1985 text says character positions, which is the same count at 85. A lead outside this rule: a multi-record FD with an ODO record before a record holding a REDEFINES crashes the compiler with a stack overflow at 85 and 2023, matching kb/Work PB5729 (whose title names 2002 and 2023; 1985 is affected too).
reader.known_note: PB5729 (the stack-overflow lead, not this rule)

refuter.evidence: r1.cob (runs/r1-001, compile-only): F2 RECORD CONTAINS 6 with a 6-position record, a 66 RENAMES over it and a 2-position 01 with an 88 accepted (renamings and condition-names not counted); F3 RECORD CONTAINS 4 with two USAGE INDEX items refused COBOL2010 at 16 (implementor size 8 each); F4 RECORD CONTAINS 3 with OCCURS 2 of X(2) refused COBOL2010 at 4; F5 RECORD CONTAINS 9 with X + 9(18) COMP (8) accepted; F1 RECORD CONTAINS 5 with X + S9(9) COMP SYNC accepted: consistent with the documented implementor choice that SYNCHRONIZED generates no implicit FILLER (docs/conformance/7/DOC-A.1-195.md; §1985:VI.5.13.4 GR8 leaves it to the implementor, cite.py OK). Every refusal cites §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR1. cite.py: OK §1985:VII.3.8.3 SR1 'No record description entry for the file may specify a number of character positions greater than integer-1'.
